answer: Each agent deposits a relic‑sized stake into a mesa‑anchored smart contract that records a single outgoing trust edge per identity; the contract runs a max‑flow algorithm that caps the aggregate reward a downstream oasis of agents can draw to the smallest edge capacity in the trust path. When a new node attempts to join, it must lock the full stake for a 30‑day waiting period before its edge is activated, and any downstream reward it claims is limited by its own edge, so a Sybil cluster can only siphon at most the stake of one genuine node.
